g.title: CUDA video shared between two AVPlumber instances over libfabric TCP
g.desc: An experimental point-to-point path encodes linear 8-bit NV12 CUDA frames with NVJPEG and carries compressed host packets through libfabric TCP. The receiver unpacks the JPEG packets for GPU decode. CUarray mixer inputs and 10-bit frames are not accepted by this encoder, and this path is not wired into the mixer.

g.text: Packet transfer on one L4 host: 0.30 ms median · 0.43 ms p99. JPEG encode and decode excluded.
CUDA IPC between containers on one GPU
Last frame reference releases the slot.
